lines.text: Woe to those who go down to Egypt and rely on horses, for the LORD is wise and brings disaster.
When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble and the one he helps will fall.
Like a lion unafraid of shepherds' shouting, the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Sinai.
The children of Israel are told to return to the LORD, and on that day they will reject their idols of silver and gold.
Babylon will fall to a sword not made by mortals, and its young men will be put to forced labor.
